mostWorthwhile.text: Adding the watch lamp to the tower was the most worthwhile action because it completed the lighthouse at the headland.

leastWorthwhile.text: Placing the tower was a straightforward preparation, but less interesting than making or completing something.

surprise.text: Nothing particularly surprised me; the combinations and placements followed the chapter's stated goals.

arbitrary.text: No action felt especially arbitrary, although brick and a window producing an entire tower was an abbreviated construction step.

continue.text: I would be mildly interested in another chapter if it offered more consequential choices; this one was clear but quite predictable.
